title: Minimal generating sets of transfer systems for more non-Abelian Groups
summary: For a finite group $G$, $N_\infty$ operads encode collections of norm maps, and by work of Blumberg--Hill and Rubin their homotopy category is equivalent to the poset of $G$--transfer systems on the subgroup lattice of $G$. In \cite{ABB+25} the authors defined the \emph{width} $w(G)$ as the minimal size of a generating set for the complete $G$--transfer system and identified it with the number of conjugacy classes of proper meet irreducible subgroups of $G$, and the \emph{complexity} $c(G)$ as the maximum, over all transfer systems $T$, of the size of a minimal generating set for $T$.
